state:
**Goal `ext-intl` — `Novis\Intl` is built into every binary: ICU4X with every CLDR locale, batch-shaped, over `Core\Time` values — has just started; nothing of it has landed yet.** Stage 1's floor is whatever the chain carries; after goal `goal-closeout` that is nothing.

ADR 0247 § 5 fixes the scope and ADR 0051 § 3 the batch shape; the API itself is this goal's one record, written first in Stage 2. The goal file's § *Standing decisions* answers every call a session meets, the crates included, and no session re-decides one.

What the earlier M9 goals left and this goal stands on: the world and `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ext_world.rs` (goal `ext-design`), `crates/nvs-ext` (goal `ext-host`), the registration layer and source section (goal `ext-compiler`), and from goal `ext-image` the build script, the built-in set in `crates/nvs-ext/src/builtin.rs`, the crossing counter, the roster's `novis/` paths and `docs/reference/novis/Image.md`. Neither `crates/nvs-ext` nor `extensions/` existed when the goal was written, so the goal's `context` names no module in them: add the files you read with `bun nv goal context --add`.

Two facts about the tree as the goal was written. `Core\Cldr` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/cldr.rs:1625`) already answers cardinal and ordinal plural categories in Tier 0 over a closed roster, so the record says how `Novis\Intl`'s plural rules relate to it. `rule:core-api/no-ambient-state` forbids a default locale, so a locale is an argument everywhere.

items.text: **The record** — one new record, its number checked against `docs/decisions/` right before it is written: every `Novis\Intl` class, member and options shape for ADR 0247 § 5's list (`rule:core-api/one-paradigm-per-operation`), every export of `wit/intl.wit`, the batch shape (ADR 0051 § 3), a locale as an argument (`rule:core-api/no-ambient-state`), the malformed and the unsupported locale, `Core\Time` values converted to local fields by the host, the relation to `Core\Cldr`, and the tradeoffs. It creates its fragments under `docs/rules/core-classes/`.

**The proofs checks the record makes possible** — the record's last item adds one `bun nv proofs --verify --group '<class>'` check per class it names to Stage 8 of `data/goals/ext-intl.json`, wanting `nothing owed`, `0 failed`, `0 failed`.

**`wit/intl.wit` and its test** — the interface against `nvs:ext@1.0.0` in ADR 0246 § 1's types alone (`rule:packaging/a-value-crosses-as-its-wit-type`); `the_intl_interface_parses_against_the_world_in_wit_types_alone` and `every_intl_formatting_export_takes_a_list_and_returns_a_list` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ext_world.rs`, negotiation the one named exception.

backlog: Stage 3: the crate `extensions/intl/` built and embedded beside the image component (`crates/nvs-ext/build.rs`, `crates/nvs-ext/src/builtin.rs`), then collation and the one-crossing sort of 10,000 strings.
Stages 4 to 6: numbers and plural rules, dates and relative time and lists, segmentation and negotiation — one file each under `extensions/intl/src/`, all sharing `crates/nvs-ext/tests/intl.rs`.
Stage 7: the growth in both components' module docs, and `a_bundle_calls_both_built_in_components` in `crates/nvs-cli/tests/bundle.rs` (`bundle_of` at line 43).
This is the last of the M9 goals.
